meta.title: EvoOntology semantic layer
meta.description: Gives this agent a self-evolving, versioned ontology over a database, ported from ruc-datalab/EvoOntology. Activating the bundle registers three skills (build-ontology, evolve-ontology, explore-ontology), connects one local stdio MCP server that exposes 29 `mcp__evo__*` tools, and adds an EvoOntology tab to the right sidebar. The ontology records terms, field mappings, relations, constraints and evidence, so a question is grounded in the real schema instead of guessed. Building or evolving a layer runs real queries and writes into a workspace directory under `$DSH_HOME/evoontology/workspace`; nothing is sent off the machine. Needs Python 3.10+ available as `python` on PATH, or set `DSH_EVOONTOLOGY_PYTHON` to an interpreter. The vendored Python core is copied to `$DSH_HOME/evoontology/python` when the bundle activates. Turning the bundle off removes the skills, tools and panel; staged files stay until you delete them.
